diagnosis.what_happened: Persian typography rules were blindly applied to an English manuscript, causing validation to fail.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The typography enforcement lacked a language context check, applying Persian invariants universally.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The pipeline should have checked the manuscript language track before applying typography rules.
diagnosis.rationale_why: APA 7 formatting differs fundamentally by language, especially regarding digits and punctuation.

desired_behavior: Enforce language-track-aware typography: English manuscripts must follow APA 7 English rules with Western digits and leading zeros omitted for bounded metrics.
generalization: Typography and formatting invariants must be strictly conditional on the target manuscript language.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero tolerance for wrong language typography
